subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this PR advance the per-agent SQLite schema to version 12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics as part of this journal migration?
rationale: The repository policy requires explicit acceptance for schema-version advances, and that decision determines upgrade and release obligations rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
options.body: Accept the schema advance after a maintainer records approval and the PR supplies a redacted legacy-state migration and restart proof.

options.title: Defer ACP storage
options.body: Keep the audit and Memory Core migration separate and remove the ACP table/schema bump for a later approved migration.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Accept the schema advance after a maintainer records approval and the PR supplies a redacted legacy-state migration and restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged session/transcript SQLite work is the closest established owner boundary for per-agent schema evolution.
